newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Hanson started at Laing.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Hanson started at Laing.

text.p: Hanson Plc, the rump building materials group left after the demerger of the former conglomerate, was rated "long-term buy" as Credit Lyonnais Laing began coverage of the stock.
Hanson shares were up 3-1/2p at 303 by 1304 GMT in active trade of just under three million shares.

Analyst Mike Foster put a fair value estimate of 325p on the stock, pointing out it was trading at a 15 percent discount to average price-earnings ratios and a 17 percent discount in terms of its enterprise value rating.

Foster said a number of issues could constrain the stock, including uncertain growth prospects at its Grove cranes unit and the fact that some 46 percent of operating profit growth through the next two years would from one division -- bricks.
However he said the company's cash generation was good and there was "plenty of raw material for medium-term share price performance."
